description: This file defines the TransactionService interface, which extends a generic service interface to manage Transaction entities. It includes method signatures for retrieving specific types of transactions related to orders, such as capturable and refundable transactions, and listing transactions associated with an order.

classes.name: TransactionService
classes.description: An interface for managing transactions related to orders, extending a generic entity service.

methods.name: getCapturableTransaction
methods.description: Retrieves a previous transaction of type authorize for a given order, potentially for capture purposes.

methods.name: getRefundableTransaction
methods.description: Retrieves a transaction of a refundable type for a given order.

methods.name: listTransactions
methods.description: Lists all transactions associated with a given order.
